description: Token-risk report for one Base ERC-20 contract. Checks whether the token can be sold (honeypot simulation), buy/sell/transfer tax, owner privileges (mint, pause, blacklist, balance changes, proxy upgrades), holder concentration and DEX liquidity. Returns ALLOW, WARN, BLOCK or INCOMPLETE with scored findings and per-check coverage. INCOMPLETE means required evidence was unavailable, never zero risk. Read-only: never signs or trades. Paid tool: 0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing.
name: token_risk
title: Token Risk
